updates.body: Block production on Solana mainnet beta resumed at 14:57 UTC, following a successful upgrade to v1.17.20 and a restart of the cluster by validator operators. Engineers will continue to monitor performance as network operations are restored. The outage began at approximately 09:53 UTC, lasting 5 hours. Core contributors are working on a root cause report, which will be made available once complete.
Engineers from across the ecosystem are investigating an outage on mainnet-beta
This incident has been resolved.
The Solana community successfully restarted the cluster - engineers will continue to monitor network performance

A coordinated restart is underway to address an issue during the upgrade from 1.13 to 1.14 that caused block finalization to slow significantly. Validators: please follow updated instructions below https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vQVMKVqh1o-qF4Z8ATM-Qxa_FhT96qoCmqGHFroq4e1EbrHkfg-H8Q8Z_FRnX3mYOxRgBbK6yzDols_/pub

Engineers are currently investigating slow root production on mainnet beta. 2023-02-25 05:46:16 UTC the Solana network entered degraded mode (vote-only). This means that economic activity on the network stopped while the network attempts to recover. Core contributors of the protocol are working to identify the root cause of this issue.

A coordinated restart is underway to address an issue during the upgrade from 1.13 to 1.14 that caused block finalization to slow significantly. Validators: please follow instructions below https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vQzf7XpdoXB99lCWu6na9PhLy4SOx-xcjP1LlGiVR0PB6vpyGpol1c8_PufAa8TZZp_R0NlgaqlC7a1/pub
The Public RPC and Explorer endpoints are online.

Mainnet beta Public RPC endpoints and Explorer are currently offline as RPC node software is upgraded, following a bug in a test release 1.14. This bug impacted other nodes which had adopted the test release. If you are operating a node on a test release, please change over to 1.13. Block production has not been impacted and the Solana network remains online.
Validator operators successfully completed a cluster restart of Mainnet Beta at 7 AM UTC. Network operators an dapps will continue to restore client services over the next several hours.

The Solana network is experiencing an outage and not processing transactions. Developers across the ecosystem are working on diagnosing the issue and to restart the network. More information will be provided as it becomes available.
The Solana Network is currently experiencing degraded performance. Developers across the ecosystem are working on diagnosing the issue and more information will be provided as it becomes available.

Validator operators successfully completed a cluster restart of Mainnet Beta at 9:00 PM UTC, following a roughly 4 and a half hour outage after the network failed to reach consensus. Network operators and dapps will continue to restore client services over the next several hours.

items.title: Release v4.3.0-beta.1
items.notes: > [!WARNING] > **This release has no binary artifacts and must not be deployed. Use `v4.3.0-beta.2`.** > > The build for this tag failed `cargo audit` on > [RUSTSEC-2026-0258](https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0258) > (`h2` 0.4.13), so no Linux, macOS, or Windows assets were produced. > Crates for `4.3.0-beta.1` were published before the failure was detected and > have since been yanked. > > Superseded by `v4.3.0-beta.2`, which carries the same changes plus the > advisory mitigation. #### Changes since v4.3.0-beta.0 - v4.3: fix(core): silence dead_code for alpenglow_slot_clock on non-unix (backport of #14542) (#14565) - v4.3: gossip: wrap epoch slots index after 254 (backport of #14566) (#14571) - v4.3: [ed25519] bump solana-signature version (backport of #14578) (#14602) - v4.3: replay: allow execution of leader banks after SwitchBank (backport of #14580) (#14604) All of the above are included in `v4.3.0-beta.2`.
